items.securityDecision: This is a build-time security policy oracle and compile-time exhaustiveness belt. It is not itself the runtime authorization check, so reports must not describe it as the live request guard; the chat verbs' guard paths remain the runtime enforcement.
items.recommendation: Keep the declaration, export, and focused tests. Treat the test-only hit as a liveness-lens false positive caused by the gate's structural, symbol-name-based consumer.
